name: SDN Host P2P Discovery
description: Capability node for the host p2p_read discovery hostcalls (gateway loop G.2). Two methods, one hostcall each: 'peers' forwards the routing-decision JSON as {"peer_id"?} to p2p.peers_snapshot (the host's peerstore/DHT/registry view: per-peer addrs, connectedness, agent version, published standards, and stored $EPM profiles as an aligned size-prefixed stream segment); 'standards' forwards to p2p.standards_snapshot (newest signed $PNM per (peer, standard) with per-entry attribution). Each method re-emits the incoming decision frame verbatim on the 'decision' port (linear flow chaining) and pushes the RAW hostcall response envelope ([u32le metaLen][{"ok":..,"result":..} JSON][u32le segCount][[u32le segLen][bytes]]*) on the 'snapshot' port; segment 0 carries the $EPM/$PNM stream referenced as {"$bin":0} in the result. A decision with route=not_found short-circuits: no hostcall, an empty-result envelope is emitted.

externalInterfaces.description: Policy-mediated read-only host discovery snapshots (peerstore + DHT + EPM registry + stored PNMs).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Discovery routing-decision JSON frame (foundation/http-route discover contract); "peerId" narrows the snapshot to one peer.

inputPorts.description: One routing-decision JSON frame per request.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The incoming decision frame re-emitted verbatim (linear chaining; no host round-trip).

Verbatim p2p.peers_snapshot hostcall response envelope: meta JSON {"ok","result":{"self","peers":[{"peer_id","addrs","connected","self","agent_version","standards","epm_index"}],"records":{"$bin":0}}} + segment 0 = aligned size-prefixed $EPM stream (stored profiles only; epm_index -1 = none).

methods.description: Forwards {"peer_id"?} to the p2p.peers_snapshot hostcall and emits the raw response envelope plus the decision passthrough.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Discovery routing-decision JSON frame (foundation/http-route discover contract).

inputPorts.description: One routing-decision JSON frame per request.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The incoming decision frame re-emitted verbatim (linear chaining; no host round-trip).

Verbatim p2p.standards_snapshot hostcall response envelope: meta JSON {"ok","result":{"entries":[{"peer_id","standard","schema","file_id","file_name","cid","publish_timestamp","pnm_index"}],"records":{"$bin":0}}} + segment 0 = aligned size-prefixed $PNM stream (newest per (peer, standard), entry order).

methods.description: Forwards to the p2p.standards_snapshot hostcall and emits the raw response envelope plus the decision passthrough.
